title: LocaleHazard: replication package for 'Correct Contract, Wrong Text: Text Roles in Locale-Sensitive Operations Across Repairs, Static Analyzers, and PostgreSQL'
description:
Replication package for the study "Correct Contract, Wrong Text: Text Roles in Locale-Sensitive Operations Across Repairs, Static Analyzers, and PostgreSQL". It contains a controlled cross-ecosystem benchmark (construct demonstration), GitHub repair-commit mining with a diff-based classifier and coded validation samples (RQ1), role-paired probes and recorded outputs of twelve static analyzers and Semgrep (RQ2), and a PostgreSQL 18.6 collation-data change experiment validated against a real glibc 2.27 runtime (RQ3).
